nodes.label: processState
nodes.rationale: Diagnostic only; no absence, birth identity, parent/path correlation, poll limit, host completion or cleanup predicate uses process state. State observations are neither atomic attestation nor native-cause evidence.

nodes.label: SRUN / RUNNABLE
nodes.rationale: Runnable; does not measure CPU activity.

nodes.label: SZOMB / ZOMBIE
nodes.rationale: Awaiting collection by its parent; a zombie remains PRESENT under the unchanged identity classifier.

nodes.label: OTHER
nodes.rationale: Any other status; no further interpretation.

nodes.label: source-pin.json
nodes.rationale: Exclusive receipt records source/header/output and selected Node/SDK header hashes plus exact command. Source, compilation success and hashes do not qualify runtime compatibility, containment, native process state or cause.

nodes.label: M02 owned Code Mode host observer
nodes.rationale: Inert offline preparation for a later reviewed T2 command; offline tests perform no native Codex start, socket, provider, process metadata query, auth, inference or grant.
nodes.norm_label: m02 owned code mode host observer

nodes.label: spawnOwnedCodex
nodes.rationale: Trusted spawn port returns the live owned child and stopOwned callback, or cleans up before rejecting. The observer exposes no public PID-taking method and never signals a process.

nodes.label: stopAndVerify()
nodes.rationale: Always requests owned cleanup; qualifies cleanup only after live-host completion and owned Codex exit and close events. Binding failures also request cleanup within a fixed poll bound.

nodes.label: UNKNOWN cleanup
nodes.rationale: Ambiguous cleanup has cleanupKnown: false and must not be treated as no effect. Observation failure fences the case and is not a negative host finding.

nodes.label: Native addon
nodes.rationale: Pins parent birth identity to live child; enumerates at most 15 direct children, checks current parent and birth identities and rechecks parent. Unknown children fail closed; polling and PID reuse races prevent an atomic OS snapshot.

nodes.label: allowedDirectChildPaths
nodes.rationale: Later T2 composition must supply the exact scoped MCP child executable path as the sole reviewed entry; no allowlist is inferred.

nodes.label: verifyPinnedHostBinary()
nodes.rationale: No-follow file descriptor checks inode, owner, mode and SHA-256 at preparation time; does not attest process image, provenance, security isolation or exact spawn count.

nodes.label: Pure C++ result classifier
nodes.rationale: proc_pidinfo absence is accepted only for zero with ESRCH; a short response or zero without ESRCH is uncertain. Has a standalone offline selftest.

nodes.label: Exact T2 source/manifest review
nodes.rationale: Before native use, review must pin addon build hash, host pin, MCP path, source, tests and command.

nodes.label: Apple libproc implementation
nodes.rationale: proc_listchildpids receives buffer bytes but returns a PID count.
